summary_1line: Sugriva orders the monkeys to burn Lanka, causing citywide destruction and panic before Ravana dispatches new demon forces to counterattack.

image_candidates.scene_text: Armies of monkeys swarm through Lanka at night carrying flaming torches as golden palaces erupt into fire across the city.
Terrified citizens of Lanka flee burning mansions while elephants and horses break loose and race through streets glowing with flames.
Rama stands drawing his great bow before the burning city, its thunderous twang shattering a massive gate like a mountain peak.
